utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Morning, all. Monday the seventh. Everyone on? I've got a bit of an echo.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, we're here. Two laptops in the same room, that's all.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Better now?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Lovely. Before we start, the charity bake sale on Friday was good. Some fairly ambitious slices of cake going round.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Structural cake. You could have built a wall with mine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Would've gone nicely with a coffee, if it weren't for the broken coffee machine in the canteen.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That thing's basically an ornament now.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Still better than the heating in the portakabin. Tropical in there this morning. Just having a moan, not adding it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Factory-standard climate control. Coat on, coat off.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the facilities appreciation society—what's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Already swapped the filter on the WHB yesterday. That's done, not something for today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. That filter's off the outstanding list.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And finished the repair on the palletiser last night. That's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Nice to start with something actually finished.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: One observation: saw the pressure on the turbine one dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I saw the pressure on the turbine one dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Same event, I reckon, not a second dip.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Okay, observation only, then. We're not creating a job off that here.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I'm still waiting on parts for the WHB, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Separate from the filter I've just mentioned, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, separate outstanding work. Still blocked, no action on that today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Callum, can you run a function test on the guard switch on two by end of day? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll run the function test on the guard switch on two by end of day. That takes precedence.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And Tomasz Nowak, can you check the guarding on the guard switch on two by end of day? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll check the guarding on the guard switch on two by end of day. Urgent, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just so we're not muddling those together—physical guarding check and the function test are two separate bits.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. Mine's the function test, not saying the guarding's signed off just because the switch operates.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, that's how I've understood it too.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: While we're on sign-offs, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel by 11am. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks, Han. The lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel is yours, by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep. That's the one I need to keep clear time for.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Han, can I give you the sensors as well—recalibrate the sensors on the line 3 chiller this morning, top priority please?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that as well. Not with the urgent sign-off I've just committed to. I'd be promising time I haven't got.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fair enough. Priya, can you take that instead: recalibrate the sensors on the line 3 chiller this morning? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead of Han. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the line 3 chiller this morning, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out for a second—sensors, not a general chiller service?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sensors, yeah. Recalibration. Nothing broader being added.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right. I'll sort the training records for the new starters by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's Grace Liu against the training records, by Thursday, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's me, yes. I'll sort those.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Where does the shift handover report sit against the urgent stuff?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Callum, can you send the shift handover report round this afternoon? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, I'll send the shift handover report round this afternoon. Low priority, after the urgent bit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, don't want the report jumping ahead of that function test.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, definitely not. Low priority still stands for the report.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I've got another one, separate from this morning. I'll swap the filter on the Water Booster Pump on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya. On Friday, whenever you get a chance. That's not one to squeeze ahead of the urgent work.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Agreed. I'll do the Water Booster Pump filter on Friday, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And that's not my completed WHB filter job. Different entry, before anyone crosses both out.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, definitely separate. Easy enough to hear 'filter' and stop listening.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Also, I'll chase the purchase order for the booster pump on the 3rd. Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Grace against the booster pump purchase order, with 'on the 3rd' as the due wording?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, keep that wording. I'll chase it on the 3rd; fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I'll grease and check the bearings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel next Tuesday. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Callum Reid for the bearings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel, next Tuesday. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, mine. It matters but it's not urgent, so it stays next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And that one's separate from the line 3 chiller work this morning. Same line number, different job.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah. Chiller sensors with me, bearings with Callum Reid. No overlap there.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, does anyone have a different understanding of what they've accepted?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, all clear here.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Clear. And thanks for moving the recalibration rather than leaving it against both of us.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, nothing doubled up my end. Completed stuff and the blocked WHB work are separate.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: All good. Apart from the coffee situation, obviously.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We nearly managed a whole meeting without coming back to that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: An heroic effort. Right, thanks everyone. That's us.
